name: Kouno Kenichi
source:
The protagonist. A university student who aims to become a music teacher.
His piano skill is considerable, but he is troubled by the fact that his playing lacks “something.”
He also has martial arts experience from his boyhood, and thanks to that foundation his physical strength is above average.
He is not good at relying on others and tends to try to carry everything on his own.
This is also true with Kiri, his maid: while he accepts her kindness, he restrains himself from depending on her completely.
He is very strait-laced and serious. He is poor with alcohol.
He does not have many friends, but Ryusuke is his best friend.
